Prayer Intent Assistant

Prayer intent (niyyah) is essential in Islam. This tool helps you refine your intentions, strengthen your focus, and deepen your connection with Allah during prayer.

Prayer Intent Assistant

AI-powered guidance to enhance your niyyah (intention) and khushu' (concentration) in prayer

​
Help me focus on gratitude in my prayer
I want to feel more connected to Allah
Guide me to pray with full concentration
Help me understand the meaning of what I recite
I struggle with distraction during prayer
About Prayer Intent

The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said: "Verily, deeds are [judged] by intentions, and for every person is what he intended."

Having a clear and focused intention before prayer helps you to achieve khushu' (mindful focus) and derive the most spiritual benefit from your prayers.

This assistant uses AI to provide personalized guidance on improving your prayer intention and concentration, based on Islamic teachings and practices.

How It Works

1. Describe your current state of mind or what you wish to focus on in prayer

2. Get personalized guidance on strengthening your intention

3. Receive relevant duas and practical tips to implement

4. Save your favorite intentions for future prayers
